source_quality.selected_path: When the unique SEO tab is already selected, no click is sent. Otherwise the existing trusted pointer driver clicks the uniquely observed main SEO control. The subsequent linked-pane predicate requires aria-selected=true, so a wrong or unmounted view cannot satisfy readiness.

Reopened history must match its badge count and contain the exact real Save response ID; the selected row label must be unique, and its snapshot must expose that same ID.

limits: The current-page oracle is the captured real IANA title plus linked active pane and Re-audit state; it does not independently compare the browser tab URL after reload.
